description: Trello-like task board built from the folders and files of your project.
config.boardRoot: Folder (relative to the workspace folder) used as the board root by **Folder Kanban: Open Board**. Empty means the workspace folder itself.
config.newTaskExtension: Extension added to new task file names that have no extension (e.g. `.md`). Empty to add none.
config.exclude: Folder / file names that are never shown as task groups or tasks. Names starting with `.` are always hidden.
view.boards.welcome:
No workspace folder is open.
